claims.claim: Maya said the demo covers all three validation items.
claims.why: Maya says 'It covers all three.'

claims.claim: POS and order feeds are merged into one model refreshing every 5 minutes, with no separate streaming product.
claims.why: Devon states this directly.

claims.claim: The product reads from Northwind's change feed, not the order database.
claims.why: Devon says it reads from the change feed with no queries against the order database.

claims.claim: Sandbox peak load was about 40 reads per second.
claims.why: Devon gives this figure.

claims.claim: Carlos said the load is well under their limit.
claims.why: Carlos: 'well under what we allow.'

claims.claim: The store rollup shows projected days to reorder point for 212 stores.
claims.why: Devon states this.

claims.claim: Maya said the rollup screen is what store managers need.
claims.why: Direct quote.

claims.claim: A row-level policy on the region key limits regional managers to their own region.
claims.why: Devon states this.

claims.claim: One level of parent/child regions works out of the box, and Carlos confirmed one level is all they have.
claims.why: Devon and Carlos exchange confirms this.

claims.claim: Maya is ready to take this to Priscilla Grant, the CFO, who signs anything over $200K.
claims.why: Maya says this.

claims.claim: The deal's ACV is $310K.
claims.why: CRM acv_usd is 310000.

claims.claim: A 30-minute CFO meeting is planned for Tuesday, Oct 6 at 10:00.
claims.why: Maya says she'll set up 30 minutes Tuesday Oct 6 at 10.

claims.claim: Maya wants store managers to see on-hand including open orders within minutes, to stop shipping to full stores.
claims.why: Maya states this goal.

claims.claim: Maya needs cost per store and the overstock reduction for the CFO business case.
claims.why: Maya asks for these.

claims.claim: Carlos was worried about order database load after a past vendor hammered it; this was resolved.
claims.why: Carlos raised it, Devon answered, Carlos said fine.

claims.claim: Carlos wants the change feed setup documented for their ops runbook.
claims.why: Carlos states this.

claims.claim: Priscilla has no stated concerns yet and will presumably focus on cost and ROI.
claims.why: No concerns stated is true, but the cost and ROI focus is speculation.

claims.claim: Maya cited an overstock reduction 'modeled together last month', but CRM shows only a Sept 14 discovery call with 'Agreed the TV items.'
claims.why: Maya's reference and the CRM note match the claim. The output flags the inputs as untraceable.

claims.claim: The CRM economic_buyer field is blank and Priscilla has no email or phone.
claims.why: The CRM shows economic_buyer empty and no email or phone for Priscilla.

claims.claim: The Oct 6 invite depends on Maya sending it, and nothing is confirmed on Priscilla's side.
claims.why: Maya said she'd set it up. No CFO confirmation was stated.

claims.claim: The decision process is undocumented beyond the $200K signature threshold; security, legal and procurement steps are unknown against a Dec 18 close.
claims.why: CRM says decision process 'Not discussed', close date is 2026-12-18, and only the CFO threshold was said.

claims.claim: The 5-minute refresh and 40 reads/sec peak came from a sandbox extract, so production behavior at scale is not shown.
claims.why: Both figures were described as sandbox.

claims.claim: The call did not confirm whether 212 stores is Northwind's full footprint.
claims.why: Nobody addressed footprint. The output flags it as unconfirmed.

claims.claim: The meeting time zone for the 10:00 CFO meeting was not stated.
claims.why: Maya said only '10'. The output marks the time zone as needing confirmation.

claims.claim: The session ran about 9 minutes and no competitor, security or compliance topics came up.
claims.why: CRM demo window is 09:00 to 09:09, and the transcript has none of those topics.

claims.claim: Devon will send Carlos the change feed setup doc today (Sept 28).
claims.why: Devon: 'I'll send you the setup doc today.'

claims.claim: Hannah will send Maya the business case numbers by Friday, Oct 2.
claims.why: Hannah agreed to send by Friday the 2nd.

claims.claim: Maya will set up a 30-minute meeting with Priscilla on Oct 6 at 10:00.
claims.why: Maya says she'll set up 30 minutes.

claims.claim: Hannah and Devon will both attend the Oct 6 CFO meeting.
claims.why: Hannah says 'I'll be there with Devon.'

claims.claim: CRM close_the_demo lists only Devon's commitment without a due date, and Hannah's Oct 2 deliverable is not recorded.
claims.why: CRM sc_commitment is 'Change feed setup doc' with no date, and Hannah's deliverable is absent.
